title: Tenant entitlement
description: What a team is entitled to. Abstract on purpose: no Kubernetes object names.

name.description: Team name. Becomes the namespace name, so it must be a DNS label.

gpuCap.description: Ceiling on concurrently requested nvidia.com/gpu. A ceiling, not a reservation.

tier.description: Priority under contention. Mapped to a PriorityClass inside the chart (templates/_helpers.tpl).

computePool.description: any = prefer datacenter, spill to cloud. datacenter | cloud = required, never spills.

networkIsolation.description: namespace = ingress only from the same namespace. The only mode built; new modes are how exceptions become capabilities.
